Managing the editorial calendar, writing to SEO standards, formatting for each platform, and hitting publish on time is operationally expensive. Kleza’s automation layer removes that burden. Your brand publishes consistently, your team focuses on strategy.

What we automate

Editorial Oversight

AI generates. Humans approve. Always.

Every piece of automated content passes through a Kleza editorial team before it goes live. We do not publish raw AI output. Our editors verify factual accuracy, brand voice consistency, HIPAA compliance for healthcare clients, and SEO quality before scheduling.
